SouthState Bank | HYBRID — Charleston SC, Columbia SC, Winter Haven FL, or McKinney TX | Full time | U.S. work authorization required

SouthState is actively hiring for two engineering roles and committed to reviewing and responding to applicants.

SouthState Bank is a regional financial institution building modern, secure banking and payment platforms.

Payment Platform DevOps Engineer

Build and automate Azure infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security controls, and deployment processes for payment systems.

Technologies: Azure, Terraform, GitHub Actions

Apply: https://careers.southstatebank.com/us/en/job/R-05240/Payment...

AI Platform Engineer 1

Build the cloud platform, reusable services, and development frameworks used to deliver secure enterprise AI applications.

Technologies: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework

Apply: https://careers.southstatebank.com/us/en/job/R-05241/AI-Plat...

When applying please mention this post.
